newsitem.title: USA: Bids sought for So. Calif. commercial power load.
newsitem.headline: Bids sought for So. Calif. commercial power load.

text.p: E&Y Kenneth Leventhal, a unit of Ernst & Young LLP, on Thursday opened a "request for proposals" for electricity supplies to a Southern California industrial client after the state begins to allow competition in the retail market next January.
The client is "a large Southern California commerical electrical energy consumer," according to the real estate consulting firm's statement.
The buyer has typical demand of 140 megawatts (MW) between 0230 and 0530 PT and typical maximum demand of 270 MW at 1430 PT, the consulting firm said.
The firm's client aims to aggregate power supplies to Southern California properties through a multi-year contract with a single electricity provider.
Responses to the request are due by May 15.
